description: Vuex folders state + accordion UI + assign-to-folder controls + i18n. Depends on FEAT-001 (the `folder` field must already exist end-to-end). Renders accounts as collapsible folder sections in a single screen, with an 'Ungrouped' section for folderless accounts, and lets the user assign folders inline and at account creation.
steps: In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\src\definitions\module-interface.d.ts: add `collapsedFolders: string[];` to the AccountsState interface.

In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\src\store\Accounts.ts: initialize `collapsedFolders: []` in state; add a `folders` getter returning the distinct non-empty `entry.folder` values across state.entries, sorted via localeCompare; add mutation `setFolder(state, payload: { entry: OTPEntryInterface; folder: string })` that sets `state.entries[payload.entry.index].folder = payload.folder` (mirror pinEntry); add mutation `toggleFolderCollapsed(state, folderName: string)` that adds/removes folderName in state.collapsedFolders. Leave the existing pinned-first `entries` getter unchanged.

In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\src\components\Popup\EntryComponent.vue: map the `accounts/folders` getter via mapGetters; add a folder text input inside the inline-edit area (alongside the existing issuerEdit inputs shown while editing) bound to a shared `<datalist>` of existing folder names; on change call a `setFolder` method that commits `accounts/setFolder` with { entry, folder } then `await EntryStorage.set(this.$store.state.accounts.entries)` — mirror the existing `pin()` method. Use i18n keys folder / folder_placeholder.

In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\src\components\Popup\AddAccountPage.vue: add `folder: ""` to the newAccount data object and its type; add a folder text input + `<datalist>` (fed by the `accounts/folders` getter) inside the advanced <details> section; pass `folder: this.newAccount.folder` into the `new OTPEntry({...})` constructor call.

In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\src\components\Popup\MainBody.vue: render the accordion as a presentation layer (NOT interleaved dragula rows). Compute sections from the `entries` getter: an 'Ungrouped' section (entries with falsy folder) first, then one section per name from the `folders` getter. Each section is a collapsible header whose click commits `accounts/toggleFolderCollapsed(name)` and whose collapsed state is read from `collapsedFolders`; the body is a list of EntryComponent rows filtered to that folder. When `folders` is empty, render the current single flat `v-dragula` list unchanged (preserve the dropModel -> accounts/moveCode -> EntryStorage.set flow and the no-entry empty state). When sections render, either give each section its own dragula list (per-folder drake) for within-folder reorder, or if per-section drakes prove flaky, scope drag to the flat list only and record the limitation in this feature's findings. Do NOT silently break existing reordering. Use the i18n `ungrouped` string for the default header.

In c:\Users\Noah\Documents\projects\Authenticator\.worktrees\folders\_locales\en\messages.json: append `folder`, `ungrouped`, and `folder_placeholder` entries (each `{ "message": ..., "description": ... }`) before the closing brace. Other locales fall back to en.

Optional if feasible: add a component test under src/test/components/Popup/ (follow MenuPage.test.ts) asserting that entries without a folder render under the Ungrouped section and that assigning a folder moves a row; if the full runner can't execute on Windows, still ensure the test file compiles in the webpack test bundle.
acceptance_criteria: AccountsState has `collapsedFolders: string[]`; Accounts module exposes a `folders` getter, `setFolder` and `toggleFolderCollapsed` mutations; the pinned-first `entries` getter is unchanged.
EntryComponent inline edit has a folder input (datalist of existing folders) that persists via setFolder mirroring pin().
AddAccountPage advanced section has a folder input and passes folder into the new OTPEntry.

MainBody renders collapsible folder sections with an Ungrouped section first; folderless entries appear under Ungrouped and never crash; the no-folders case keeps the current flat list and working drag-reorder.
`npx webpack --config ./webpack.config.js` builds with zero fork-ts-checker TypeScript errors.
`npx eslint . --ext .js,.ts` reports no errors; changed files pass `npx prettier --check`.
verification: From the worktree root run `npx webpack --config ./webpack.config.js` and confirm a successful build with no TypeScript errors from ForkTsCheckerWebpackPlugin (paste summary lines).

Run `npx prettier --check` on each changed file (module-interface.d.ts, Accounts.ts, EntryComponent.vue, AddAccountPage.vue, MainBody.vue, _locales/en/messages.json, any new test); run --write then re-check if diffs.
Conceptually confirm (and in review) that an entry with empty folder renders under the Ungrouped section and does not crash, and that the no-folders path keeps the existing single-list drag behavior.
If Puppeteer + Chrome available, build the test bundle and run `node scripts/test-runner.js`; otherwise rely on the compile.
findings: Implemented. Store: AccountsState.collapsedFolders (string[]) added to module-interface.d.ts; Accounts.ts initializes collapsedFolders: [], adds `folders` getter (distinct non-empty entry.folder values, sorted via localeCompare), `setFolder(state, { entry, folder })` mutation (sets state.entries[entry.index].folder, mirrors pinEntry), and `toggleFolderCollapsed(state, folderName)` mutation (splice/push into collapsedFolders). The pinned-first `entries` getter is unchanged. UI: EntryComponent.vue inline-edit area gained a folder text input bound to entry.folder with a shared <datalist id="folderList"> of the `folders` getter; on change it calls setFolder() which commits accounts/setFolder then `await EntryStorage.set(...)`, mirroring pin(). AddAccountPage.vue advanced <details> gained a folder input + <datalist>, `folder: ""` in newAccount data + its type, and passes `folder: this.newAccount.folder` into new OTPEntry. i18n: added folder, ungrouped, folder_placeholder to _locales/en/messages.json. MainBody.vue: presentation-layer accordion. When the `folders` getter is empty, the ORIGINAL single flat v-dragula list renders unchanged (preserving entryDrake, the dropModel -> accounts/moveCode -> EntryStorage.set reorder flow, and the no-entry empty state). When folders exist, a non-dragula grouped view renders: a `folderSections` computed builds an 'Ungrouped' section first (entries with falsy folder, labeled via i18n.ungrouped) then one section per folder name; each section has a clickable header that commits accounts/toggleFolderCollapsed and v-show's its body based on collapsedFolders. Folderless entries always appear under Ungrouped and never crash (empty folder is falsy). DRAG-SCOPE DECISION/LIMITATION: drag-reorder is scoped to the flat (no-folders) list only. Per-folder dragula drakes were intentionally NOT added — v-dragula uses a single named drake ('entryDrake') wired to global dropModel indices against the flat state.entries array, and interleaving multiple per-section drakes with the pinned-first/folder-filtered presentation ordering would make dropModel's dragIndex/dropIndex not correspond to real state.entries indices, risking silent corruption of entry order on reorder. So within-folder reordering is not available while folders are in use; existing flat-list reordering is fully preserved when no folders exist. Verification (from worktree root, Windows/PowerShell, eslint/prettier run via `cmd /c` to avoid PS arg mangling): `npx webpack --config ./webpack.config.js` -> 'webpack 5.94.0 compiled successfully', zero fork-ts-checker TS errors (the build type-checks all .vue/.ts). `npx eslint . --ext .js,.ts` -> exit 0, no output/errors. `npx prettier --check` on all 6 changed files -> initially flagged (LF vs CRLF normalization), ran `--write` then re-check -> 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'. git diff --stat confirms only additive changes (module-interface.d.ts +1). Optional component test NOT added: Puppeteer runner is non-headless with a hardcoded ext id (unreliable on Windows, same as FEAT-001); the webpack build proves type-correctness. No archive/archived field or UI added; MIT LICENSE, branding, and cloud credentials untouched; folder values are small strings so chrome.storage.sync payloads stay small.
